# PowerDealDesk
> Free public directory of Australian National Electricity Market (NEM) battery storage (BESS) and solar+battery hybrid projects, built from public AEMO Generation Information records, plus guides and optional Pro/Team research subscriptions. Contact: deals@powerdealdesk.com

## Key pages
- [Project directory (SA projects, filterable)](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/nem-bess-tracker/)
- State pages: [NSW](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/nsw/), [QLD](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/qld/), [VIC](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/vic/), [SA](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/sa/)
- Project pages: https://powerdealdesk.com/au/projects/<slug>/ (one per AEMO site)
- [List or claim your project](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/list-your-project/)
- [Home, plans and free brief](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/)

## Data (public-record fields only)
- [projects.csv](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/data/projects.csv)
- [projects.json](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/data/projects.json)
- Source: AEMO NEM Generation Information, July 2026

## Notes
- Readiness scores and rankings are subscriber-only and not published.
- Featured listings are advertising; no brokerage or success fees.
- Last updated 2026-10-19.
